snippet.title: PSX Longplay [718] Kitchen Panic (JP)
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: NPI

This is one of the hardest platformers on the PS1, maybe even the hardest game there is for the console. What makes it so difficult is the controls such as jump+down is long jump, and jump+down in mid-air facing a wall is high jump (if you accidentally press up on the d-pad, which most people would do instinctively, the potato will launch himself down).

Completely stupid controls, but it is beatable after practicing it. What is hardly beatable is collecting 10 pots on each level. But as you all know these longplays use re-recording so it was possible to do that too. Don't understand who will do it on a real console.

After the end of the game at 03:42:14 I went through one last bonus level to collect the last 10 pots, and for the 100% completion reward got nothing.

Disclaimer: Most videos by World of Longplays use SaveStates!
